## Summary

Locale and theme switching are implemented at the **App layer** via Riverpod `NotifierProvider`s wired into `MaterialApp.router`. The canonical **UI** is `AppSettingsMenu` (ChoiceChip-based bottom sheet). **`glasses_app` has persistence + MaterialApp wiring but no settings UI hooked up yet** — only `pkg_showcase` uses `AppSettingsMenu`. There are **no `Radio` / `RadioListTile` widgets** anywhere in the repo.

---

## 1. Locale / Language Switching

### Architecture (per-package l10n, App aggregates)

- Spec: `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/specs/cross-cutting/l10n.md`
- Guide: `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/docs/i18n.md`
- Each Feature/Common package owns `assets/l10n/*.arb` + `flutter gen-l10n` output under `lib/src/l10n/generated/`
- App aggregates delegates in `MaterialApp.router`; supported locales: **`zh`, `en`**

### App-layer wiring

**`glasses_app`** — `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app.dart`

```302:333:/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app.dart
    final themeMode = ref.watch(glassesThemeModeProvider);
    final locale = ref.watch(glassesLocaleProvider);
    // ...
    return DeviceAutoConnectGate(
      child: MaterialApp.router(
        // ...
        themeMode: themeMode,
        locale: locale,
        localizationsDelegates: [
          ...GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegates,
          GlassesShellL10n.delegate,
          // ... many feature delegates
        ],
        supportedLocales: const [Locale('zh'), Locale('en')],
      ),
    );
```

**`pkg_showcase`** — same pattern in `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/pkg_showcase/lib/src/showcase_app.dart` (lines 273–305).

### Riverpod providers (app locale)

| App | Provider | File | Persistence | API |
|-----|----------|------|-------------|-----|
| `glasses_app` | `glassesLocaleProvider` | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app_state.dart` | Yes — `StorageService` key `glasses_locale` | `ref.read(glassesLocaleProvider.notifier).set(Locale?)` — `null` = follow system |
| `pkg_showcase` | `localeProvider` | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/pkg_showcase/lib/src/app_state.dart` | No — in-memory only | `ref.read(localeProvider.notifier).set(Locale?)` |

```48:65:/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app_state.dart
class GlassesLocaleNotifier extends Notifier<Locale?> {
  StorageService get _storage => ref.read(storageServiceProvider);

  @override
  Locale? build() {
    final saved = _storage.getString(_localeKey);
    return saved != null ? Locale(saved) : null;
  }

  void set(Locale? locale) {
    if (locale == null) {
      _storage.remove(_localeKey);
    } else {
      _storage.setString(_localeKey, locale.languageCode);
    }
    state = locale;
  }
}
```

### UI for app locale

**Reusable widget:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/widget/app/widget_app_settings/lib/src/app_settings_menu.dart`

- `_LocaleSection` — 3 `ChoiceChip` options: System (`null`), `zh`, `en`
- Opens via settings icon → `showModalBottomSheet`
- **Only wired in** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/pkg_showcase/lib/src/home_page.dart` (lines 60–67)
- **`glasses_app` does NOT import `widget_app_settings`** — providers exist but no UI calls `.set()`

### Feature-level language selection (not app locale)

Separate from app i18n — for AI translate/interpretation language pairs:

| Pattern | File | Provider |
|---------|------|----------|
| Bottom sheet + `ListTile` + check icon | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/ai/feature_translate/lib/src/pages/widgets/translate_language_bar.dart` | `selectedTranslateLanguagesProvider` in `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/ai/feature_translate/lib/src/model/selected_translate_languages_provider.dart` |
| Same pattern | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/ai/feature_interpretation/lib/src/pages/widgets/interpretation_language_bar.dart` | `selectedLanguagesProvider` |

### Network headers (not synced to locale)

`Accept-Language` is hardcoded `'zh-CN'` in both apps' `networkConfigProvider` (`glasses_app/lib/app.dart:98`, `pkg_showcase/lib/src/showcase_app.dart:56`). `buildAuthNetworkHeaders()` accepts `acceptLanguage` but defaults to `'zh-CN'` — **no dynamic sync with `glassesLocaleProvider`**.

## 2. Theme / Dark Mode Switching

### Architecture

- Spec: `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/specs/cross-cutting/theme.md`
- Guide: `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/docs/theming.md`
- **`DesignTokens`** (`/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/core/core_theme/lib/src/model/design_tokens.dart`) is the single source of truth
- Features read `DesignTokens.of(context)` — never `ColorScheme` directly
- `MaterialApp` uses `theme` / `darkTheme` / `themeMode`; `ThemeMode` drives light/dark `ThemeData` shell

### App token definitions

| App | Light/Dark tokens | File |
|-----|-------------------|------|
| `glasses_app` | `kGlassesTokens` / `kGlassesDarkTokens` → `appTheme` / `darkAppTheme` | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/glasses_app_tokens.dart` |
| `pkg_showcase` | `lightTheme` / `darkTheme` from `DesignTokens.light()` / `.dark()` | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/pkg_showcase/lib/src/app_state.dart` |

### Riverpod providers (theme mode)

| App | Provider | File | Persistence | API |
|-----|----------|------|-------------|-----|
| `glasses_app` | `glassesThemeModeProvider` | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app_state.dart` | Yes — key `glasses_theme_mode`, values `system`/`light`/`dark` via `ThemeMode.name` | `ref.read(glassesThemeModeProvider.notifier).set(ThemeMode)` |
| `pkg_showcase` | `themeModeProvider` | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/pkg_showcase/lib/src/app_state.dart` | No — defaults `ThemeMode.system` | `ref.read(themeModeProvider.notifier).set(ThemeMode)` |

### UI for theme mode

**Same `AppSettingsMenu`** — `_ThemeSection` with 3 `ChoiceChip`s: System / Light / Dark.

L10n strings in `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/widget/app/widget_app_settings/assets/l10n/app_zh.arb` (`themeSettings`, `themeSystem`, `themeLight`, `themeDark`).

## 3. Settings / Preference UI Patterns

### Primary reusable pattern — `AppSettingsMenu`

**File:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/widget/app/widget_app_settings/lib/src/app_settings_menu.dart`

| Sub-component | Widget | Use case |
|---------------|--------|----------|
| `_SettingsSection` | Section title + child | Grouped settings |
| `_ChoiceChipButton` | `ChoiceChip` with `DesignTokens` styling | **Single-select preferences** (locale, theme) |
| `_AccountSection` | `TextButton` / `FilledButton` | Login/logout |
| Container | `showModalBottomSheet` + `SafeArea` | Settings panel |

**Exports:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/widget/app/widget_app_settings/lib/widget_app_settings.dart`  
**README:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/widget/app/widget_app_settings/README.md`

**Constructor API:**
```dart
AppSettingsMenu(
  locale: Locale?,
  themeMode: ThemeMode,
  account: AppSettingsAccount,
  onLocaleChanged: ValueChanged<Locale?>,
  onThemeModeChanged: ValueChanged<ThemeMode>,
  onLogin: VoidCallback,
  onLogout: AsyncCallback,
)
```

### Other preference UI patterns (no Radio widgets)

| Pattern | File | Notes |
|---------|------|-------|
| **`ChoiceChip`** (single-select) | `app_settings_menu.dart` | Locale + theme — closest to radio behavior |
| **`SegmentedButton`** (multi-segment filter) | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/device/feature_device_album/lib/src/pages/device_album_page.dart` | Album filter bar |
| **`ListTile` + check trailing** (single-select list) | `translate_language_bar.dart`, `interpretation_language_bar.dart` | Language picker in `DraggableScrollableSheet` |
| **`ListTile` in bottom sheet** (simple pick) | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app_shell/personal_info_page.dart` | Gender selection |
| **`ListTile` + stepper (+/−)** | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/health/feature_health_menstrual/lib/src/pages/menstrual_settings_page.dart` | `_NumberRow`, `_SettingCard` |
| **Card list rows** (Lanhu-style, no toggles yet) | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/device/feature_device_settings/lib/src/pages/device_settings_page.dart` | Device settings — shows `status: l10n.switchOn/Off` as text, `onTap: showSoon` |
| **Profile menu rows** | `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app_shell/profile_page.dart` | Navigates to device settings, not app locale/theme |

**No `Radio`, `RadioListTile`, `SwitchListTile`, or `CupertinoSwitch` found** for settings preferences.

## 4. Riverpod Providers & Storage

### App-level (locale + theme)

```
glasses_app/lib/app_state.dart
├── glassesThemeModeProvider  → GlassesThemeModeNotifier
├── glassesLocaleProvider     → GlassesLocaleNotifier
└── glassesTabIndexProvider   → (unrelated tab state)

pkg_showcase/lib/src/app_state.dart
├── themeModeProvider         → ThemeModeNotifier
└── localeProvider            → LocaleNotifier
```

### Storage layer

- `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/core/core_storage/lib/src/service/storage_service.dart`
- Injected via `storageServiceProvider`, namespaced per app (`GlassesAppConfig.storageNamespace`)
- Used by `glasses_app` locale/theme notifiers and feature prefs (e.g. translate language IDs)

### Feature-level persisted prefs (reference pattern)

`selectedTranslateLanguagesProvider` — `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/ai/feature_translate/lib/src/model/selected_translate_languages_provider.dart` — same `StorageService` + `Notifier.set()` + `unawaited(storage.setInt(...))` pattern.

## 5. What to Reuse

**For app locale + theme UI in `glasses_app`:**

1. Add `widget_app_settings` dependency
2. Place `AppSettingsMenu` in an AppBar (see `pkg_showcase/lib/src/home_page.dart`)
3. Wire callbacks:
   ```dart
   onLocaleChanged: (v) => ref.read(glassesLocaleProvider.notifier).set(v),
   onThemeModeChanged: (v) => ref.read(glassesThemeModeProvider.notifier).set(v),
   ```
4. Aggregate `AppSettingsL10n.delegate` in `glasses_app/lib/app.dart` localizationsDelegates (showcase already does this)

**For single-select preference UI:** reuse `_ChoiceChipButton` pattern from `app_settings_menu.dart` (or the whole `_SettingsSection` layout).

**For language pickers (feature-scoped):** reuse `ListTile` + check icon in `DraggableScrollableSheet` from `translate_language_bar.dart`.

**For numeric settings:** reuse `_SettingCard` + `_NumberRow` from `menstrual_settings_page.dart`.

**Gap to close if locale should affect API:** wire `glassesLocaleProvider` → `networkConfigProvider` / `buildAuthNetworkHeaders(acceptLanguage: ...)` — currently static `'zh-CN'`.
